heading:
Tenuta di Forte
Sorgnano
paragraphs:
We welcome you to Tenuta di Forte Sorgnano for the weekend. The estate sits at the top of a hill looking down on a beautiful valley of vineyards and olive groves that stretch as far as the eye can see.

As you enter the gates, you will go past the four country houses, known as the ‘hamlets’ which date back to the 19th century and have been recently renovated.

At the peak of the hill, around 500 metres from the hamlets, sits the recently renovated Lombard castle that dates back to the 8th century, which is where all the wedding day activities will be taking place (don’t worry, shuttle buses will escort guests from the hamlets or sister accommodation up to the forte).

The estate offers numerous amenities and services, including
its own dedicated restaurant.  You can relax in the wellness area
or outdoor swimming pool, hike on the trails or play various sports on the pitches. There is also the option to arrange, wine tastings, cooking classes or yoga sessions.
